## Zero interest if paid in full within 12 or 6 months

On purchases of $1200+ for 12 months or $199-$1199 for 6 months at participating locations made with
your Midas® Credit Card. Interest will be charged to your Account from the purchase date if the
promotional plan balance is not paid in full within the promotional period. Promotional Plan Fee may
apply[¹][146].

[Learn more][147]

## Golden Guarantees™

Midas proudly stands behind our guarantees on tires and parts at every location nationwide.

Included with every tire purchase[²][148]:

FREE Flat Repairs or Replacements

FREE Tire Rotation (every 5,000 miles)(every 8,000 kilometers)

FREE Alignment Checks

FREE Rebalancing (every 5,000 miles)(every 8,000 kilometers)

Guaranteed for as long as you own your vehicle[³][149]:

Brake Pads

Brake Shoes

Mufflers

Shocks & Struts

## Tires, Oil Changes and Auto Repair Services

### Oil Change+-

Oil is the lifeblood of your engine. It reduces friction, lessens wear, provides lubrication, forms
a seal between the pistons, rings and cylinder walls while helping to cool engine parts. Without the
cleaning action of new oil, carbon and varnish buildup would be toxic to the engine. [Learn more
about Oil Change][150]

[Request Appointment][151]

### Brakes & Brake Repair+-

From the brake pedal to hydraulic brake fluid, brake master cylinder to power brake booster, drum
brakes to disc brakes and electronic anti-lock brake sensors, Midas technicians know every part of
your brake system inside and out and can perform brake repair on any make and model. [Learn more
about Brakes & Brake Repair][152]

[Request Appointment][153]

### Tire Maintenance+-

Midas technicians will inspect, rotate, and balance tires as scheduled by your vehicle's
manufacturer, keeping them road-ready for any trip. For expert tire maintenance, visit your nearest
Midas location today. [Learn more about Tire Maintenance][154]

[Request Appointment][155]

### Shop for Tires+-

Midas makes tire shopping easy. Our experts are here to answer any questions you have, so you can
feel confident about your purchase. We will determine the correct size & tire type for your car and
provide financing options, expert installation and long-term tire maintenance services.

[Shop for Tires][156]

### Steering & Suspension+-

Utilizing the latest diagnostic equipment our Midas ASE-certified technicians can repair and/or
maintain your steering system, car suspension, and wheel alignment to keep you and your vehicle on
the road with a smooth ride. [Learn more about Steering & Suspension][157]

[Request Appointment][158]

### Car A/C & Heating Repair+-

Car AC systems have components that require love and attention to avoid drying out and cracking. The
car heater also needs regular check-ups to make sure there are no leaky valves or blockages. Let
your neighborhood Midas service your A/C or heater to keep you comfortable at any
temperature. [Learn more about Car A/C & Heating Repair][159]

[Request Appointment][160]

### Wheel Alignment+-

In practical terms, ensures that every wheel points in the same direction and every tire maintains
optimal contact with the road. It also helps maximize your tire investment by preventing some kinds
of uneven tire wear. This is a job for a qualified mechanic using precision equipment. And that’s
what you’ll find at your local Midas. [Learn more about Wheel Alignment][161]

[Request Appointment][162]

## Midas in the Community

At Midas, we do more than fix cars. We also help the communities where we do business by
participating in blood drives, food drives, Project Spark car donations, car-seat safety events and
much more.

Visit your local Midas to learn more or go to Project Spark to see how Midas has assisted families
in need by giving them the gift of reliable transportation.

[Go to Project Spark][163]

On purchases of $1200+ for 12 months or $199-$1199 for 6 months at participating locations made with
your Midas® Credit Card. Interest will be charged to your Account from the purchase date if the
promotional plan balance is not paid in full within the promotional period. Promotional Plan Fee may

[Learn more][147]

## Golden Guarantees™

Midas proudly stands behind our guarantees on tires and parts at every location nationwide.

Included with every tire purchase[²][148]:

FREE Flat Repairs or Replacements

FREE Tire Rotation (every 5,000 miles)(every 8,000 kilometers)

Guaranteed for as long as you own your vehicle[³][149]:

Brake Pads

## Tires, Oil Changes and Auto Repair Services

### Oil Change+-

Oil is the lifeblood of your engine. It reduces friction, lessens wear, provides lubrication, forms
a seal between the pistons, rings and cylinder walls while helping to cool engine parts. Without the
cleaning action of new oil, carbon and varnish buildup would be toxic to the engine. [Learn more
about Oil Change][150]

[Request Appointment][151]

### Brakes & Brake Repair+-

From the brake pedal to hydraulic brake fluid, brake master cylinder to power brake booster, drum
brakes to disc brakes and electronic anti-lock brake sensors, Midas technicians know every part of
your brake system inside and out and can perform brake repair on any make and model. [Learn more
about Brakes & Brake Repair][152]

[Request Appointment][153]

### Tire Maintenance+-

Midas technicians will inspect, rotate, and balance tires as scheduled by your vehicle's
manufacturer, keeping them road-ready for any trip. For expert tire maintenance, visit your nearest
Midas location today. [Learn more about Tire Maintenance][154]

[Request Appointment][155]

### Shop for Tires+-

Midas makes tire shopping easy. Our experts are here to answer any questions you have, so you can
feel confident about your purchase. We will determine the correct size & tire type for your car and
provide financing options, expert installation and long-term tire maintenance services.

[Shop for Tires][156]

### Steering & Suspension+-

Utilizing the latest diagnostic equipment our Midas ASE-certified technicians can repair and/or
maintain your steering system, car suspension, and wheel alignment to keep you and your vehicle on
the road with a smooth ride. [Learn more about Steering & Suspension][157]

[Request Appointment][158]

### Car A/C & Heating Repair+-

Car AC systems have components that require love and attention to avoid drying out and cracking. The
car heater also needs regular check-ups to make sure there are no leaky valves or blockages. Let
your neighborhood Midas service your A/C or heater to keep you comfortable at any
temperature. [Learn more about Car A/C & Heating Repair][159]

[Request Appointment][160]

### Wheel Alignment+-

In practical terms, ensures that every wheel points in the same direction and every tire maintains
optimal contact with the road. It also helps maximize your tire investment by preventing some kinds
of uneven tire wear. This is a job for a qualified mechanic using precision equipment. And that’s
what you’ll find at your local Midas. [Learn more about Wheel Alignment][161]

[Request Appointment][162]

## Midas in the Community

At Midas, we do more than fix cars. We also help the communities where we do business by
participating in blood drives, food drives, Project Spark car donations, car-seat safety events and
much more.

Visit your local Midas to learn more or go to Project Spark to see how Midas has assisted families
in need by giving them the gift of reliable transportation.

[Go to Project Spark][163]

[ 1A Auto][84] believes in empowering you, our customer, to do your own car repairs. We offer a
large selection of high quality car parts online, [ expert customer service ][85], and helpful

highest quality materials and rigorously tested for longevity, direct fit, and function. We
guarantee our replacement parts will fit as well as the original equipment. All online auto parts
you buy from 1A Auto will function as well as or better than the OEM parts, whether it’s as simple
as brake [pads][90] or as complex as a [tow mirror][91]. We are so confident in our aftermarket
parts that we guarantee correct fit for every part. Additionally, we offer some of the longest
warranties in the automotive industry.

Our friendly and knowledgeable customer service team is always ready to help. We staff our toll-free
US-based call center with auto experts excited to answer all your questions. Feel free to ask
anything about any of our products, including fit or installation. We want you to get exactly the
replacement part you need the first time around. We are well versed in all vehicle makes and models
whether your car is domestic like a [Ford][92], [Chevy][93], or [Dodge][94], or an import such as a
[Toyota][95], [Honda][96], [Volkswagen][97], or [BMW][98].

Friday, and your parts will ship from one of our auto parts warehouse the same day. That way you get
your parts and accessories fast, so you can get back on the road quickly.

dedicated to serving your automotive needs. Experience the difference of shopping with A-Premium
team that's as passionate about cars as you are.

powerful inventory and bring you the perfect shopping experience through the same-day convenience in

### Are A-Premium auto parts reliable for automotive replacement repairs?

Yes. A-Premium auto parts are engineered as high-quality **automotive replacement parts** designed
for long-term reliability. Many customers report being **extremely satisfied** with fitment,
performance, and installation results, especially when replacing **original parts**, **spark
plugs**, **fuel pumps**, sensors, and other components involved in everyday **auto repairs**.

### How do I verify the correct part number before purchasing A-Premium parts?

Each A-Premium part includes a dedicated **part number** that matches the OEM reference. You can use
our **vehicle** compatibility tool, cross-check the **OEM number**, or contact our support team to
confirm the correct **replacement part**. This prevents ordering the **wrong** item and ensures the
component will **match** your car.

### Are A-Premium parts OEM-quality or better?

A-Premium products are manufactured to meet or exceed **OEM** specifications. Customers consistently
highlight the **quality**, durability, and “**works great**” performance across key components such
as **brakes**, cooling systems, ignition parts, and **pads**. Our testing process ensures each
**replacement part** offers reliable and safe operation.

### How long does shipping take when ordering from A-Premium.com?

Orders processed through [**A-Premium.com**][6] ship from our U.S. **warehouse** with fast,
trackable delivery. Most **car parts** arrive within a few business days. You will receive full
tracking information to monitor your **package**, ensuring the item is delivered on time for your
repair **job**.

### What should I do if the part I received does not fit my vehicle?

If a part doesn’t fit, first **verify** your **part number** and vehicle details. If the item is
incorrect, A-Premium offers easy **refund** and exchange options. Our team will help identify the
**right ones** for your **car**, ensuring you receive the correct **replacement part** without
delay.

### Do A-Premium automotive parts come with customer support or warranty service?

Yes. Every purchase includes professional after-sales **service**, technical guidance, and warranty
coverage. Customers frequently mention having a **great experience** with our support team when
troubleshooting installation issues, confirming compatibility, or replacing **discontinued** or
hard-to-find components.

A-Premium offers **premium**-grade **car parts** at a competitive **price**, making them a strong
alternative to dealership or vendor markups. Many customers note that our components are **cheaper**
than OEM dealers while delivering **excellent** performance and reliability. This makes A-Premium an
ideal choice for drivers, DIY mechanics, and repair shops.

Most A-Premium components are designed for straightforward installation. Customers often report that
parts such as sensors, filters, **spark plugs**, and ignition components “**installed** easily” and
“**worked great**.” Clear instructions, accurate fitment, and consistent quality help simplify the
repair process.

Yes. A-Premium provides a full suite of **automotive replacement parts** for major makes including
**Hyundai**, Honda, Toyota, Ford, Chevrolet, and more. Whether you need ignition parts, **brakes**,
cooling components, or **fuel pump** replacements, we support a wide range of fitment coverage.

# We sell quality parts from proven suppliers

Your car parts are very important to us. That’s why we never use unscrupulous no-name suppliers that
don’t take pride in the product they sell. We only sell high quality brand name products, to ensure
you with the best factory backed warranty in the industry, and that’s a promise.

[ PRODUCT LINES ][53]

### **** NOTIFICATION ****

#### Meet Jessica, Our Automated Counterperson

##        **You can now order through Jessica, our automated counterperson.**** If our live
## counterpersons are assisting other customers, your call will be automatically routed to Jessica.
## You will also have the option to select Option 1 when calling our main number to be connected
## directly to Jessica.**

## **       **

## **       In addition, Jessica is available after our regular business hours, allowing you to
## place orders at your convenience. Any orders placed outside of operating hours will be processed,
## and your parts will be delivered on the next business day.**

** **

## **       Jessica is designed to make ordering faster and more efficient. She can check
## availability, find parts by description, vehicle, VIN, or license plate, and answer product
## questions. You can also start an order, add items, save your cart, and return to it later to
## review and place your order when you’re ready.**

** **

## **      We’re always looking for ways to improve your experience, and we hope this new option
## will make ordering faster and more flexible for you.**

##  

## **       To place orders with Jessica, all customers must have a Nexpart account and a specific
## access code. If you do not have an account and a code please reach out to your account
## representative for assistance.**

# AAA makes the road of life easier to travel

**Roadside Assistance  •  Insurance  • 
Travel  •  Banking  •  Discounts**

[Get a Quote][193]
[Explore Membership][194]
[Manage My Membership / Insurance][195]
[AAA roadside assistance technician replacing a flat tire.]
become a member

## Roadside peace of mind starts with AAA

There's more to AAA Membership than a tow. From flat tires to dead batteries, AAA Classic Membership
includes 24/7 AAA Roadside Assistance.*

[Learn More][196] [Choose Your Plan][197]
get car insurance

## Protect what matters to you

We know it’s not just about what you drive, but who’s driving too.

[Learn More][198] [Get a Quote][199]
[Car on open road.]
[moving in to new home]
[A cheerful senior couple travelers with motorbike in countryside. ]
[family with rv]
[Young family standing together in front of new house.]
[couple on boat]
[couple on laptop]
[Street flood from a tropical storm.]
[A family walking down a path with mom and dad holding the young kids hand.]

## insurance types

### We've got you covered
* [Car][200]
* [Renters][201]
* [Motorcycle & ATV][202]
* [RV][203]
* [Home][204]
* [Boat][205]
* [Life][206]
* [Flood][207]
* [Umbrella][208]

#### [Car] AAA Car Insurance

Protect your ride and the people inside. We’ll work together to create a policy that helps meet your
unique insurance needs and ensures you have all the discounts you qualify for. Plus, filing claims
is easy so you can get back on the road.  

[Get a Quote][209] [Learn More][210]

#### [Apartment] AAA Renters Insurance

No matter where you choose to stay, you should feel comfortable and protected. That’s why our rental
insurance, also known as apartment insurance, offers affordable premiums and excellent coverage for
where you call home.

[Learn More][211]

#### [Motorcycle] AAA Motorcycle & ATV Insurance

Whether you have two wheels, three wheels or more, we help protect your outdoor fun from the
unexpected. Our AAA Motorcycle & ATV Insurance helps keep your toys safe, so every time you ride,
you can focus on what lies ahead.

[Learn More][212]

#### [RV] AAA RV Insurance

Protect your recreation vehicle, motor home, travel trailer, pickup cap and camper. No matter where
you choose to explore, you can rest assured that your stuff is safe, secure and covered with one of
our AAA RV Insurance plans.

[Learn More][213]

#### [House] AAA Home Insurance

It’s one of your most valuable assets. Maybe the largest piece of your retirement planning. Protect
the investment you’ve made in your home by insuring it through a company you can trust when you need
it the most. 

[Get a Quote][214] [Learn More][215]

#### [Boat] AAA Boat Insurance

As a boater, you’re all about the water. We get it. From powerboats to sailboats and everything
in-between (including trailers!), we have the coverage you need with on-water towing, fuel spill
protection, total loss replacement and more.

[Learn More][216]

#### [Life] Life Insurance through AAA

Protect your family from the unexpected. Find the right AAA Life Insurance Company policy that works
for you. By planning for it now, with a range of coverage terms, you can ensure the financial
security and peace of mind for your family in the future.

[Learn about Life][217] [Why use an Agent?][218]

#### [Flood] AAA Flood Insurance

Flooding can threaten your home and belongings. In that event, the last thing you want to think
about is coverage. But with added protection like our AAA Flood Insurance, you can become reimbursed
for damages, repairs or replacements.

[Learn More][219]

## insurance types

### We've got you covered
* [Car][200]
* [Renters][201]

* [RV][203]
* [Home][204]
* [Boat][205]
* [Life][206]

#### [Car] AAA Car Insurance

Protect your ride and the people inside. We’ll work together to create a policy that helps meet your
unique insurance needs and ensures you have all the discounts you qualify for. Plus, filing claims
is easy so you can get back on the road.  

[Get a Quote][209] [Learn More][210]

#### [Apartment] AAA Renters Insurance

No matter where you choose to stay, you should feel comfortable and protected. That’s why our rental
insurance, also known as apartment insurance, offers affordable premiums and excellent coverage for
where you call home.

[Learn More][211]

#### [Motorcycle] AAA Motorcycle & ATV Insurance

Whether you have two wheels, three wheels or more, we help protect your outdoor fun from the
unexpected. Our AAA Motorcycle & ATV Insurance helps keep your toys safe, so every time you ride,
you can focus on what lies ahead.

[Learn More][212]

#### [RV] AAA RV Insurance

Protect your recreation vehicle, motor home, travel trailer, pickup cap and camper. No matter where
you choose to explore, you can rest assured that your stuff is safe, secure and covered with one of
our AAA RV Insurance plans.

[Learn More][213]

#### [House] AAA Home Insurance

It’s one of your most valuable assets. Maybe the largest piece of your retirement planning. Protect
the investment you’ve made in your home by insuring it through a company you can trust when you need
it the most. 

[Get a Quote][214] [Learn More][215]

#### [Boat] AAA Boat Insurance

As a boater, you’re all about the water. We get it. From powerboats to sailboats and everything
in-between (including trailers!), we have the coverage you need with on-water towing, fuel spill
protection, total loss replacement and more.

[Learn More][216]

#### [Life] Life Insurance through AAA

Protect your family from the unexpected. Find the right AAA Life Insurance Company policy that works
for you. By planning for it now, with a range of coverage terms, you can ensure the financial
security and peace of mind for your family in the future.

[Learn about Life][217] [Why use an Agent?][218]

#### [Flood] AAA Flood Insurance

Flooding can threaten your home and belongings. In that event, the last thing you want to think
about is coverage. But with added protection like our AAA Flood Insurance, you can become reimbursed
for damages, repairs or replacements.

[Learn More][219]

Previous Next

## A Note from our Founder & president

The performance aftermarket has always been a cycle of growth and recession. Today’s market shifts
present compounding challenges. Declining customer numbers, shrinking profit margins, and complex
vendor consolidations make it clear that traditional business practices are no longer sufficient.

Automotive Integrations was founded to foster collaboration. We believe in sharing industry
insights, effective strategies, growth pathways, and implementing technologies that drive results –
things that matter to all of us.

We can work together to develop strategies that revitalize your business. From integrating
cutting-edge technologies to creating dynamic marketing campaigns, we help streamline operations and
connect you with your target market.

Simply surviving isn’t enough. Our own journey has shown us the importance of adaptation and
strategic partnerships. We’ve witnessed firsthand how these strategies can dramatically improve
customer engagement and drive business growth. At Automotive Integrations, we’re excited about the
future and confident in our ability to help you navigate whatever challenges lie ahead.

We help automotive aftermarket businesses grow their business and improve their operations.

## We Can Help You, Too

### Sell More Products

Do you have a product business but are experiencing slower sales growth? Our experts will work with
you to develop your sales channels to meet customer demand for your products.

### Expand Your Services

Exploring new service offerings to meet the needs of your existing customers and attract new
business? We provide consulting, strategy, and implementation services.

### Grow Your Brand

Automotive Integrations can help you scale your business with clear and effective messaging that
attracts new customers and keeps your current clientele up to date on your latest offerings.

## A Note from our Founder & president

The performance aftermarket has always been a cycle of growth and recession. Today’s market shifts
present compounding challenges. Declining customer numbers, shrinking profit margins, and complex
vendor consolidations make it clear that traditional business practices are no longer sufficient.

Automotive Integrations was founded to foster collaboration. We believe in sharing industry
insights, effective strategies, growth pathways, and implementing technologies that drive results –
things that matter to all of us.

We can work together to develop strategies that revitalize your business. From integrating
cutting-edge technologies to creating dynamic marketing campaigns, we help streamline operations and
connect you with your target market.

Simply surviving isn’t enough. Our own journey has shown us the importance of adaptation and
strategic partnerships. We’ve witnessed firsthand how these strategies can dramatically improve
customer engagement and drive business growth. At Automotive Integrations, we’re excited about the
future and confident in our ability to help you navigate whatever challenges lie ahead.

[ Work With Us > ][45]

# Engineering decisions that survive the shop floor.

BlackRock Engineering develops machinery, automation, embedded software, and engineering tools
around the constraints that determine whether a system works in production.

[Start a technical review][24][Explore our work][25]
Concept / analysis / detailed design / deploymentDrag to inspect

Engineering capability

## One team across the physical and digital system.

We support the work from early constraints through detailed design, software, commissioning, and
production improvement. Scope stays explicit; deliverables stay usable.

01

### Mechanical design and analysis

Machine design, structural verification, FEA, thermal systems, drawings, and production-ready CAD
developed around real loads and manufacturing constraints.

CAD / FEA / drawings / BOM

02

### Automation, robotics, and tooling

Robotic cells, conveyors, fixtures, end-of-arm tooling, and integration support designed for
operator access, cycle time, safety, and maintainability.

Cells / fixtures / integration

03

### Embedded systems and firmware

Device firmware, control interfaces, IoT connectivity, and testable embedded software that connects
physical hardware to reliable operations.

Firmware / IoT / controls

04

### Engineering software, CAD automation, and AI

CAD add-ins, data pipelines, engineering applications, and focused AI tools that remove repetitive
work without obscuring engineering judgement.

APIs / add-ins / data / AI

05

### Prototyping and additive manufacturing

Design-for-manufacture reviews, rapid prototypes, functional parts, and short-run production used to
validate fit and performance before larger commitments.

DfAM / prototypes / parts

Operating context

## From factory floor to production software.

01

### Shop floor

Machines, welding, assembly, tooling, maintenance, and the people operating the process.

02

### Engineering office

Requirements, CAD, analysis, controls, documentation, risk, and project decisions.

03

### Connected systems

Firmware, data, applications, CAD automation, and AI tied back to physical outcomes.

Selected evidence

## Work that left the screen.

[

Robotics / production automation

### Dual-cobot production cell

Tens of thousands of finished parts produced

][27][

Mechanical / manufacturing tooling

### Fixtures built for repeatability

Production access, datum control, and serviceability

][28][

CAD automation / engineering software

### Inventor Thread Modeler

True thread geometry for FEA and additive workflows

][29]

What Clients Say

## Customer Testimonials

”
5 out of 5 stars

Josh is a hardworking, hands-on engineer. He is very willing to take on any problems challenges and
be successful with them. I worked with Josh, he was our engineer. He pitched in where ever and did
whatever was necessary to get the job done.

[Photo of Shrini Mundlur, P.Eng. CET]

### Shrini Mundlur, P.Eng. CET

Product Design and Development Engineer

”
4 out of 5 stars

Blackrock Engineering established our dual Cobot digital printing cell, and we have successfully
printed tens of thousands of medals for amateur sports globally. Their work was efficient and neat,
and we discovered several new methods to reduce material costs.

[Photo of Ian Pierce]

### Ian Pierce

Owner, Digital Print Shop

”
5 out of 5 stars

Blackrock Engineering created a modern and responsive website for our restaurant. My favorite part
is the interactive ordering system.

[Photo of Daniel Sanchez]

### Daniel Sanchez

Owner/Operator, Lucha Tacos

”
5 out of 5 stars

Blackrock Engineering's can topper, designed specifically for our automated system has significantly
streamlined our process.

[Photo of Tim Stein]

### Tim Stein

Master Brewer, True North Brewing

Engineering notes

## Practical project notes, in development.

# Engineering decisions that survive the shop floor.

BlackRock Engineering develops machinery, automation, embedded software, and engineering tools
around the constraints that determine whether a system works in production.

[Start a technical review][24][Explore our work][25]
Concept / analysis / detailed design / deploymentDrag to inspect

Engineering capability

## One team across the physical and digital system.

We support the work from early constraints through detailed design, software, commissioning, and
production improvement. Scope stays explicit; deliverables stay usable.

01

### Mechanical design and analysis

Machine design, structural verification, FEA, thermal systems, drawings, and production-ready CAD
developed around real loads and manufacturing constraints.

CAD / FEA / drawings / BOM

02

### Automation, robotics, and tooling

Robotic cells, conveyors, fixtures, end-of-arm tooling, and integration support designed for
operator access, cycle time, safety, and maintainability.

Cells / fixtures / integration

03

### Embedded systems and firmware

Device firmware, control interfaces, IoT connectivity, and testable embedded software that connects
physical hardware to reliable operations.

Firmware / IoT / controls

04

### Engineering software, CAD automation, and AI

CAD add-ins, data pipelines, engineering applications, and focused AI tools that remove repetitive
work without obscuring engineering judgement.

APIs / add-ins / data / AI

05

### Prototyping and additive manufacturing

Design-for-manufacture reviews, rapid prototypes, functional parts, and short-run production used to
validate fit and performance before larger commitments.

DfAM / prototypes / parts

Operating context

## From factory floor to production software.

01

### Shop floor

Machines, welding, assembly, tooling, maintenance, and the people operating the process.

02

### Engineering office

Requirements, CAD, analysis, controls, documentation, risk, and project decisions.

03

### Connected systems

Firmware, data, applications, CAD automation, and AI tied back to physical outcomes.

## Why Choose DENSO?

It’s simple. The DENSO brand is built on delivering more Quality, Reliability, and Value than any
other manufacturer. Whether supplying the world’s automakers with reliable OE parts or developing
aftermarket replacement parts at or above spec, DENSO’s line of products is built to deliver
superior all-around performance every day. Our First Time Fit® philosophy attracts attention
throughout the automotive world, while our commitment to pushing technology into the future
continually sets us apart around the globe. Read below for more ways DENSO rises above the rest.

## A Spark Plug for Everyone

Utilizing decades of experience developing the world’s leading spark plugs, the DENSO family of
spark plugs is unmatched in longevity, durability, increased power, economy and reliability.
* [Iridium TT®][81] – More power, economy, and endurance with the world’s smallest tip.
* [Platinum TT®][82] – Twin tip platinum design with superior longevity and durability.
* [Iridium Power®][83] – Maximum spark energy from the 0.4mm Iridium center electrode.
* [Iridium Racing®][84] – Reliable ignition even under the harshest racing conditions.
* [Iridium Long Life][85] – Improve longevity with the first automotive plug to use Iridium.
* [Double Platinum][86] – Two Platinum electrodes means added durability.
* [U-Groove][87] – A channeled ground electrode means greater fuel efficiency.

## Aftermarket Parts Built at or Above Spec

The quality of DENSO parts is guaranteed because every component that leaves a DENSO factory has
been designed with precision, manufactured to the strictest OE standards or above, and subjected to
rigorous safety and performance tests. In the end, it all comes down to quality — that’s what the
DENSO name stands for.

## Why Choose DENSO?

It’s simple. The DENSO brand is built on delivering more Quality, Reliability, and Value than any
other manufacturer. Whether supplying the world’s automakers with reliable OE parts or developing
aftermarket replacement parts at or above spec, DENSO’s line of products is built to deliver
superior all-around performance every day. Our First Time Fit® philosophy attracts attention
throughout the automotive world, while our commitment to pushing technology into the future
continually sets us apart around the globe. Read below for more ways DENSO rises above the rest.

## A Spark Plug for Everyone

Utilizing decades of experience developing the world’s leading spark plugs, the DENSO family of
spark plugs is unmatched in longevity, durability, increased power, economy and reliability.
* [Iridium TT®][81] – More power, economy, and endurance with the world’s smallest tip.
* [Platinum TT®][82] – Twin tip platinum design with superior longevity and durability.
* [Iridium Power®][83] – Maximum spark energy from the 0.4mm Iridium center electrode.
* [Iridium Racing®][84] – Reliable ignition even under the harshest racing conditions.
* [Iridium Long Life][85] – Improve longevity with the first automotive plug to use Iridium.
* [Double Platinum][86] – Two Platinum electrodes means added durability.
* [U-Groove][87] – A channeled ground electrode means greater fuel efficiency.

## Aftermarket Parts Built at or Above Spec

The quality of DENSO parts is guaranteed because every component that leaves a DENSO factory has
been designed with precision, manufactured to the strictest OE standards or above, and subjected to
rigorous safety and performance tests. In the end, it all comes down to quality — that’s what the
DENSO name stands for.

## Measure Everything for a First Time Fit

First Time Fit® is a promise that DENSO makes to the aftermarket, by providing products that are OE
grade or better – and fits the first time. We know technicians want to get the job done right the
first time, that’s why each DENSO part is precision-built to exact specifications, so it fits
properly on every make and model covered. The DENSO First Time Fit line of products includes oxygen
sensors, compressors, starters, alternators, fuel pumps, oil and air filters, wipers, and much more.
No component leaves our factories without meeting the strictest standards and rigorous safety and
performance tests. We’re proud to say all DENSO aftermarket products are as good as or better than
original equipment.

## Efficiency, Reliability, and Savings

Over half a century ago DENSO began designing and supplying to OEMs. Since 1972, aftermarket
products created exclusively by DENSO have been available for domestic, European and Asian import
vehicles. Since the beginning, DENSO has consistently provided distributors with products featuring
wide coverage across makes and models, quick and easy installation the first time for technicians,
and product reliability and longevity for consumers. All this translates to more money savings at
all levels, making DENSO a clear choice.

For over 70 years, DENSO has been on the cutting edge of automotive technology by contributing new
products, materials, and designs to the OE and aftermarket industry. From the development of the
fuel pump module for a quality replacement option, direct ignition coils, and the open valve
impeller fuel pump, to DENSO being the first manufacturer to use Platinum and Iridium in spark
plugs, and introducing the unique U-Groove spark plug design, DENSO is continually on the front
lines of product advancement.

## There are Hundreds of Vehicle Models Around the World Built With DENSO

Since 1949, DENSO parts have been the global choice for the top automakers, with hundreds of vehicle
models rolling off the assembly line with DENSO under the hood. There are a lot of choices when it
comes to automotive parts, wouldn’t you want to choose the manufacturer selected by all the biggest
names in the automotive industry?

# How WeeL Works

##### Book Online

We ensure you get the Right mobile car repair, by the Right People, at the Right Price.

##### We Come To You

What works for you? Whether it's mechanics coming to your driveway or a nearby partner shop, you
always have options.

##### Certified Mechanics

WeeL is independently owned and committed to finding you the best mobile automotive repair
solutions. We are not connected to any manufacturer, dealership, or service facility.

## Services for everyone and every vehicle

Whether you know what you need or not, our partnered mechanics can fix it all!

[Schedule an Appointment][6]

## Experience Convenient, Reliable, and Affordable Mobile Car Repair Service

Get matched with a certified mobile mechanic on a date and location of your choice, and WeeL will
come to you! No more excuses for overdue oil changes or keeping winter tires on until July. Taking
care of your car has never been simpler with our mobile auto repair service.

## Drive Now. Pay Later.

Get back on the road today with our flexible financing options. WeeL ensures you can fix your car
without breaking the bank.

## Thousands of Satisfied Customers

Great service. Picked my car up right from my home. Diagnosed the problem and seemed to do as much
as possible to find a better price on replacement parts. Overall transparent and very communicative.
Definitely recommend Rob and his team.

back on the road without any surprises.

**Johnny C.**

Fantastic service and fantastic team who took care of everything. I would definitely recommend them.

**Jeff M.**

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How do you determine who is going to work on my car?**

Our mechanics are fully insured and licensed. Based on the location, type of vehicle, and the
required repair or service, we select the technician best suited to work on your vehicle.

**Why do you have a grace period for arrival for mobile appointments?**

Unfortunately, there are many uncontrollable variables that can make a mobile technician late for an
appointment, including weather, traffic, and parts delivery delays. We ask that you allow an arrival
buffer for these unforeseen delays.

**Will using WeeL void my new car warranty?**

WeeL will not void your new car warranty. As a car owner, you have the right to get your vehicle
repaired or maintained wherever you choose. WeeL uses parts approved by your manufacturer, and
provides proper documentation of the service

**Do you offer towing services?**

Yes, we do offer towing services.

**What’s the ‘WeeL Fair Market Price’?**

Our focus is providing customers with quality and reliable automotive maintenance and repair
solutions, which is priced competitively. The ‘WeeL Fair Market Price’ is a reasonable price for the
repair based on the type of vehicle, type of repair and location where the service is being
performed. It’s our goal to ensure our customers receive proper service, and that our repair
partners are properly compensated for their work.

**How do car repair loans work?**

WeeL uses trusted partners such as Afterpay to help you drive now and pay later. Available at
checkout. For more information, pleas visit [www.afterpay.com/en-CA][7]

**If I have my tires changed at my house, will you carry my tires into my home?**

Due to insurance reasons, we cannot enter customers’ homes or leave the driveway area. Your vehicle
must be parked on your driveway, with the tires beside the vehicle, or the tires easily accessible
in your garage. We cannot lift tires from shelves or go up and down stairs.

**What is WeeL’s Warranty?**

Unless otherwise stated, WeeL provides a 1 year or 20,000 km warranty on all parts and service. The
warranty start date begins on the date the vehicle was repaired.

**Can I request my car only be fixed in a shop?**

If you prefer not to use our mobile services, we would be happy to connect you to one of our shop

# “Service is the difference, we get it!”


# Proudly Offering Aftermarket Auto Parts Since 1958


# Welcome to Hahn Automotive

Hahn Automotive, headquartered in Rochester, NY, is the Eastern U.S. supplier of choice for
automotive aftermarket parts. We have [9 full-service warehouses][29] and 29 pick-up warehouses from
the Midwest through the Northeast and down the Mid-Atlantic states. We also own 90+ auto parts
stores that provide [products][30] to professional service dealers and do-it-yourselfers.
[Automotive Aftermarket Parts Rochester, NY]

## Proudly Offering Aftermarket Auto Parts Since 1958

[Automotive Aftermarket Parts Rochester, NY]

Our warehouses have an extensive inventory with millions of parts from the industry's most reputable
brands. Our products consist of nationally branded automotive hard parts such as ACDelco, Standard
Motor Products and WIX Filters as well as private label products like Parts Master. We also carry an
extensive stock of maintenance items, accessories, and private label products for domestic and
foreign vehicles.

[Learn More][31]

We live by our motto, “Service is the difference, we get it!” Our goal is to exceed your
expectations, and we look forward to working with you for many years to come.

## IM Auto Parts – Your Automotive Parts Supplier.

### 30% Off Retail Prices on Average.

Driving a fully serviced car means keeping yourself and other road users safe, which is why regular
vehicle inspections are important. If you suspect the slightest malfunction, buy car parts online to
solve problems with your auto before they happen. If you need new parts here and now, IM Auto Parts
can deliver replacements for any defective or underperforming piece. Engine and braking system
components, ABS, sensors, tie rods – you name it. Need genuine or aftermarket options? We offer both
so you can compare and decide which fits your vehicle best. [Go to our catalog][29] comprising
hundreds of auto components and snatch discounts on selected items. Ensure the safety and
serviceability of your vehicle without cutting corners on quality!

IM Auto Parts is dedicated to helping vehicles run more safely and efficiently. We are part of Sheng
Hai and have been building our reputation as an auto parts manufacturer for over 20 years. We
provide drivers and repair shops with replacements and accessories for cars to minimize accidents
around the globe. Whether there’s something that needs a fix in North America, Europe, Asia or any
other continent, we can deliver it. 

With IM Auto Parts, you can order:
* Genuine components made by the vehicle’s manufacturer
* OEM options that have the same technical characteristics as your original parts
* Aftermarket products that redefine automotive quality

Going for aftermarket products no longer means disregarding the auto parts manufacturer’s standards.
What we supply is certified to meet the specifications and operation requirements. All the items
have been tested to ensure they function correctly in motion and you face zero difficulties during
installation.

## IM Auto Parts – Your Automotive Parts Supplier.

Driving a fully serviced car means keeping yourself and other road users safe, which is why regular
vehicle inspections are important. If you suspect the slightest malfunction, buy car parts online to
solve problems with your auto before they happen. If you need new parts here and now, IM Auto Parts
can deliver replacements for any defective or underperforming piece. Engine and braking system
components, ABS, sensors, tie rods – you name it. Need genuine or aftermarket options? We offer both
so you can compare and decide which fits your vehicle best. [Go to our catalog][29] comprising
hundreds of auto components and snatch discounts on selected items. Ensure the safety and
serviceability of your vehicle without cutting corners on quality!

IM Auto Parts is dedicated to helping vehicles run more safely and efficiently. We are part of Sheng
Hai and have been building our reputation as an auto parts manufacturer for over 20 years. We
provide drivers and repair shops with replacements and accessories for cars to minimize accidents
around the globe. Whether there’s something that needs a fix in North America, Europe, Asia or any
other continent, we can deliver it. 

With IM Auto Parts, you can order:
* Genuine components made by the vehicle’s manufacturer

* Aftermarket products that redefine automotive quality

What we supply is certified to meet the specifications and operation requirements. All the items

installation.

# 商用電動車整車控制器（VCU）與 AUTOSAR 量產平台

  container packaging - our team will be happy to calculate it for free as part of our service
* ## multinational team

* ## availability

  quantity, feel free to ask our sales team

KETAI Industries provides a full range of services as a wholesale supplier of car parts and
accessories. We sell spare parts for cars and trucks, car tools, repair tools, car optics, auto
electrics, pneumatic equipment for car services and equipment for car wash companies.

### so why ketai industries?
* ## advanced it
  
  With our customer portal we provide customers detailed and combined information about all their
  order which helps to track our relationships and never lost any data related to the orders /
  payments / shipments
* ## quality control
  
  We have an in-house quality control team that travels between all the manufacturing facilities to
  double-check the quality of each order produced. With 2,298,700pcs of products shipped in 2019 we
  have less than 0.02% claim rate
* ## pricing
  
  Being one of the top-selling automotive parts brands in Eastern Europe we understand very well how
  important the initial cost of the goods is for our final customers and we do believe that we are
  doing an excellent job in providing it by growing 25% per year (2017-2019 data)
* ## products
  
  With more than 30,000 SKUs available from our manufacturing facilities from Automotive Parts to
  Instruments and Washing Equipment we are covering most of the needs for every company related to
  the automotive industry, which is a good way to lower your management and HR costs - no need to
  manage dozens of factories
* ## flexible supply chain
  
  We have warehouses in three regions of China, with the ability to provide you online view on your
  products, online database of your products and full flexibility in terms of most efficient
  container packaging - our team will be happy to calculate it for free as part of our service
* ## multinational team
  
  The management and employees of our company are from both - Europe and Asia, which helps us to use
  the best of the world and provide excellent service and support to our customers from all over the
  world keeping close to their culture while keeping the high-level quality and low prices
  simultaneously
* ## availability
  
  We are available 7 days a week, 16 hours per day
* ## samples
  
  We trust our products and ready to share samples with you, most of the items are free in 1-2pcs
  quantity, feel free to ask our sales team

## Responsibility

MAHLE is committed to bringing sustainable development and technical progress into perfect alignment
in the interest of efficient, environmentally friendly mobility. In doing so, we strive to reconcile
the economic success of our company with the requirements of the environment, society, and our
employees.

[Sustainability at MAHLE][126]

## Focus on security, flexibility and independence

As a foundation owned corporate, we pursue a conservative and diversified financing strategy aimed
at ensuring sufficient liquidity and financial flexibility at all times.

Our aim is to secure financial independence of our group, limit financing risks, and ensure we are
able to exploit business opportunities at all times at reasonable costs.

[Investor Relations][127]

## Aftermarket

MAHLE Lifecycle and Mobility is the business unit specializing in spare parts and services for the
aftermarket. It uses the expertise from original equipment series production for its established
product range and additional competence in electrification and digitalization and supplies partners
in the trade, workshops, and engine repair shops.

[MAHLE Lifecycle and Mobility][128]

## MAHLE - We shape future mobility!

MAHLE is a leading international development partner and supplier to the automotive industry with
customers in both passenger car and commercial vehicle sectors. Founded in 1920, the technology
group is working on the climate-neutral mobility of tomorrow, with a focus on the strategic areas of
electrification and thermal management as well as further technologies to reduce CO2 emissions, such
as fuel cells or highly efficient, clean combustion engines that also run on renewable fuels, such
as hydrogen. Today, one in every two vehicles globally is equipped with MAHLE components.

Are you ready to shape the future of mobility? Then, come join our team and we will be
#StrongerTogether. Find opportunities and take your career into the future. Join MAHLE now.

[MAHLE Career][125]

## Responsibility

MAHLE is committed to bringing sustainable development and technical progress into perfect alignment
in the interest of efficient, environmentally friendly mobility. In doing so, we strive to reconcile
the economic success of our company with the requirements of the environment, society, and our
employees.

[Sustainability at MAHLE][126]

## Focus on security, flexibility and independence

As a foundation owned corporate, we pursue a conservative and diversified financing strategy aimed
at ensuring sufficient liquidity and financial flexibility at all times.

Our aim is to secure financial independence of our group, limit financing risks, and ensure we are
able to exploit business opportunities at all times at reasonable costs.

[Investor Relations][127]

## Aftermarket

MAHLE Lifecycle and Mobility is the business unit specializing in spare parts and services for the
aftermarket. It uses the expertise from original equipment series production for its established
product range and additional competence in electrification and digitalization and supplies partners
in the trade, workshops, and engine repair shops.

[MAHLE Lifecycle and Mobility][128]

## MAHLE - We shape future mobility!

MAHLE is a leading international development partner and supplier to the automotive industry with
customers in both passenger car and commercial vehicle sectors. Founded in 1920, the technology
group is working on the climate-neutral mobility of tomorrow, with a focus on the strategic areas of
electrification and thermal management as well as further technologies to reduce CO2 emissions, such
as fuel cells or highly efficient, clean combustion engines that also run on renewable fuels, such
as hydrogen. Today, one in every two vehicles globally is equipped with MAHLE components.

## Mobility leader with unrivalled scale

## South Africa’s leading automotive group

## Track record of excellence of more than 70 years in the industry

## About Us

Motus is a diversified (non-manufacturing) business in the automotive sector with unrivalled scale
and scope in South Africa, and a selected international presence mainly in the United Kingdom and
Australia and a limited presence in South East Asia, and Southern and East Africa.

[Read more][40]

## [Our business][41]

Fully integrated business
model across four segments:

[

## Import and Distribution

][42]

### Import and Distribution
* Exclusive South African importer of four respected international brands: Hyundai, Kia, Renault and
  Mitsubishi
* Operates in South Africa and neighbouring countries
* ~16,9% passenger only new vehicle market share in South Africa
* Vehicle parc >565 000 vehicles

[Read more][43]
[

## Mobility Solutions

][44]

### Mobility Solutions
* Industry leader in the development, management and administration of innovative vehicle-related
  financial products and services
* Trusted value-added products and services provider to ~700 000 vehicle owners in SA
* Strategic partner to some of SA’s largest insurers and banks
* Provider of fleet management services, telemetry and business process outsourcing solutions
  through sophisticated technology and call centre capabilities
* Enabler of Group-wide innovation, fintech and data capabilities to discover future mobility needs
  and unlock new products and services
* Custodian of the Group’s data warehouse

[Read more][45]
[

## Retail and Rental

][46]

### Retail And Rental
* Retailed ~82 000 new vehicles and ~85 000 pre‑owned vehicles for the FY24 year
* South Africa
  * Represents 28 OEMs and 39 brands
  * ~327 dealerships
  * ~20,3% passenger only new vehicle market share
  * Vehicle Rental (Europcar and Tempest): ~140 branches and kiosks in Southern Africa
  * ~22% vehicle rental market share in SA
* United Kingdom
  * Represents 14 OEMs and 21 brands
  * ~93 commercial dealerships
  * ~35 passenger dealerships
* Australia
  * Represents 24 OEMs and 25 brands
  * ~46 passenger dealerships

[Read more][47]
[

## Aftermarket Parts

][48]

### Aftermarket Parts
* Distributor, wholesaler and retailer of parts and accessories for out-of-warranty vehicles
* Operates in Southern Africa, the UK, Asia and Europe
* Supported by distribution centres in SA, Asia, the UK and Europe
* Southern Africa
  * ~539 retail outlets and agencies (120 owned stores and 419 franchisees), supported by 10
    wholesale distribution points
  * Franchise base comprises resellers (Midas and Alert Engine Parts) and specialised workshops
* UK
  * ~181 retail outlets supported by three wholesale distribution points
* Asia and Europe
  * One agency supported by three wholesale distribution points

[Read more][49]

## Our dealerships

Unrivalled scale and scope in South Africa and a growing international presence, representing the
most respected global vehicle brands.

[View our dealerships][50]

  Mitsubishi

* ~16,9% passenger only new vehicle market share in South Africa

## Mobility Solutions

* Provider of fleet management services, telemetry and business process outsourcing solutions
  through sophisticated technology and call centre capabilities
* Enabler of Group-wide innovation, fintech and data capabilities to discover future mobility needs
  and unlock new products and services
* Custodian of the Group’s data warehouse

# Free Car Repair Manuals, Wiring Diagrams & Fault Code References

ProCarManuals is a free automotive reference resource created to help vehicle owners, DIY mechanics,
students, technicians, and automotive enthusiasts find useful repair information in one place.

You can browse car repair manuals, wiring diagrams, fuse box layouts, diagnostic trouble code
references, owner manuals, service information, self-study programs, and practical automotive
guides. The content is organized by topic, vehicle system, document type, and category so you can
find the right reference more easily.

Our goal is to make automotive information easier to access, understand, and use. Whether you are
learning how a system works, checking a wiring reference, reviewing a maintenance topic, or
researching a diagnostic code, ProCarManuals helps you explore relevant information before starting
work on a vehicle.

## Why Use ProCarManuals?
* Free access to automotive reference materials without subscriptions.
* Organized categories for manuals, wiring diagrams, fuse box diagrams, fault codes, owner manuals,
  guides, and technical references.
* Useful resources for common vehicle systems, including engines, transmissions, electrical systems,
  body components, diagnostics, and maintenance.
* Practical information for DIY users, students, technicians, and vehicle owners.
* Searchable content across many makes, models, systems, and document types.

Browse service and workshop manuals, engine references, transmission documents, wiring diagrams,
fuse box layouts, DTC fault code information, owner manuals, motorcycle manuals, truck manuals, VAG

identification, and general vehicle research.

# Free Car Repair Manuals, Wiring Diagrams & Fault Code References

ProCarManuals is a free automotive reference resource created to help vehicle owners, DIY mechanics,
students, technicians, and automotive enthusiasts find useful repair information in one place.

You can browse car repair manuals, wiring diagrams, fuse box layouts, diagnostic trouble code
references, owner manuals, service information, self-study programs, and practical automotive
guides. The content is organized by topic, vehicle system, document type, and category so you can
find the right reference more easily.

Our goal is to make automotive information easier to access, understand, and use. Whether you are
learning how a system works, checking a wiring reference, reviewing a maintenance topic, or
researching a diagnostic code, ProCarManuals helps you explore relevant information before starting
work on a vehicle.

## Why Use ProCarManuals?
* Free access to automotive reference materials without subscriptions.
* Organized categories for manuals, wiring diagrams, fuse box diagrams, fault codes, owner manuals,
  guides, and technical references.
* Useful resources for common vehicle systems, including engines, transmissions, electrical systems,
  body components, diagnostics, and maintenance.
* Practical information for DIY users, students, technicians, and vehicle owners.
* Searchable content across many makes, models, systems, and document types.

## Explore Automotive Reference Categories

Browse service and workshop manuals, engine references, transmission documents, wiring diagrams,
fuse box layouts, DTC fault code information, owner manuals, motorcycle manuals, truck manuals, VAG
self-study programs, and practical automotive guides.

These resources can help with learning, troubleshooting, maintenance planning, system
identification, and general vehicle research.

We focus on original quality engine parts. Our product range supports German, American, French and
Asian vehicle applications., delivering reliable solutions for OEM and aftermarket needs.

### Cylinder Head Assembly

Complete heads including camshafts and valves. Ready to install.

### Cylinder Block Assembly

High-strength blocks with crankshafts and pistons. Precision honed.

### Engine Gasket Kit

Full overhaul kits. Advanced materials for zero-leakage performance.

### Timing Chain Kit

Includes chains, tensioners, guides, and VVT gears. Tensile tested.

### Cooling System

Water pumps (Mech/Elec) and Oil Coolers for thermal management.

### Engine Accessory

countries, bridging the gap between premium manufacturing and local service.

# Your **Answer** To Industrial System Integration

Welcome to R.A. Moore, the System Integration Division of EWP Group. R.A. Moore leverages leading
technology to streamline manufacturing processes and optimize resources, ensuring our clients
achieve their business goals.

[ View Products & Services ][35]

[ra-moore-system-integration-warehouse-2a]

## When Precision Is Key: EWP Group

Powered by four elite divisions – equipment, instrumentation, automation, and integration – the EWP
Group engineers and implements high-tech solutions that address a variety of complex process
challenges.

We stand ready to show you the EWP Group difference. Let’s get to work.

[[RA Moore Logo with the words System Integration below]][36]

### System Integration

Our System Integration Division designs, builds, tests, safely implements, and optimizes fully
integrated solutions for continuous processing and batch operations.

[Learn More][37]
[[R.A. Moore logo]][38]

### Industrial Automation

Our Industrial Automation Division provides integrated control, monitoring, and information systems
for water and wastewater utilities, industrial processes, and communication services.

[Learn More][39]
[[MacGuire & Crawford Logo]][40]

### Instrumentation & Controls

Our Instrumentation & Controls Division offers state-of-the-art process control technologies through
partnerships with best-in-class instrumentation and controls manufacturers.

[Learn More][41]
[[E.W. Process Logo]][42]

### Mechanical Equipment

Our Mechanical Equipment Division delivers process equipment system solutions for chemical and
industrial, power generation, water and wastewater, sanitary, and municipal entities.

[Learn More][43]

## Details Matter.

### Delivering Innovative Control Solutions **for 40+ Years**

R.A. Moore has been on the cutting edge of industrial system integration since 1983.

Our designers, engineers, and technicians are qualified and equipped to design new systems and
retrofit existing ones in order to provide fully integrated solutions for continuous processing and
batch operations. As a leading industrial system integrator, our products and services are critical
to international customers across a variety of sectors, including the textile, chemical, power, food
and beverage, automotive, and pulp and paper industries.

[purple outline of two hands shaking]

Our family of companies is employee-owned, which means your success is our success. We stand ready
to solve your most complex challenges.

[purple outline of 3 workers sitting at a table with a gear overhead]

Collaboration, creative problem solving, and adaptation are just some of our superpowers. With the
EWP Group braintrust on our side, we rise to every occasion.

[purple outline of a piece of paper with a gear icon on it]

We are committed to not only providing high-quality products, but to also delivering the most
productive solutions, on time and within budget.

[purple outline of hands holding a money symbol]

Through the E.W. Gives program, we annually contribute 3% of gross profits to a variety of
organizations, including those in EWP Group communities.

## Optimize Your Entire Plant

#### SCADA Systems

Monitor and control without geographical constraints.

#### PLC/PAC/DCS Control Systems

Continuously monitor and reliably control input and output.

#### E-Houses

Minimize project timelines with prefabricated walk-in enclosures.

#### VFD/ Motor Controls

Maximize efficiency and consistency with precise motor control.

#### Pump Control Solutions

Customize and integrate systems within stations of all sizes.

#### Instrumentation & Controls

Measure, analyze and control with top-of-the-line technology.

#### Power Monitoring

Avoid significant events with real-time data analysis.

#### Turn-Key Systems

Seamlessly improve productivity with system-ready solutions.

#### Cloud Based Solutions

Perform tasks and increase efficiency while reducing workload.

#### IT Security/Cybersecurity

Minimize detection and response time with threat intelligence.

#### Wireless (RF) Communication Systems

Bolster reliability with a cohesive and cost-effective platform.

batch operations. As a leading industrial system integrator, our products and services are critical
to international customers across a variety of sectors, including the textile, chemical, power, food
and beverage, automotive, and pulp and paper industries.

to solve your most complex challenges.

[purple outline of 3 workers sitting at a table with a gear overhead]

EWP Group braintrust on our side, we rise to every occasion.

[purple outline of a piece of paper with a gear icon on it]

productive solutions, on time and within budget.

[purple outline of hands holding a money symbol]

organizations, including those in EWP Group communities.

### 30+ Years of Experience In Automotive Component Manufacturing

Founded in 1995, Tata AutoComp Systems is a leading auto component manufacturer in India. We
specialize in the design, engineering, development, and supply of a diverse range of automotive
components and systems. We provide cutting-edge solutions that address the evolving needs of the
mobility sector.

## Products and Services

### Trusted Partner to Leading Automotive OEMs

Our auto component offerings cater to automotive OEMs and span passenger vehicles, commercial
vehicles, two- and three-wheelers, tractors, off-road vehicles, allied industrial segments, and the
aftermarket. We deliver components and systems across:
* [Electricals & EV][42]
* [Interior & Exterior][43]
* [Thermal, Emission & Powertrain][44]
* [Body & Suspension System][45]

Knowledge Base 2 min read July 13, 2026

Essential fatty acids (EFAs) can prevent skin dryness and increase collagen production, leading to a
more youthful appearance.

Collagen supplements may help reduce the signs of skin aging.

Facial massage can help reduce puffiness and make the skin firmer.

A healthy diet, including fruits, vegetables, antioxidants, and vitamins, can improve skin health.

Adding a few drops of face oil to foundation can give the skin a youthful glow.

Defining one's brows and applying blush correctly can make the face appear slimmer and more
sculpted.

Bangs or lowlights can add an edgy touch to a hairstyle, while a side bang can create symmetry and
reduce the appearance of roundness in the face.

Blush should be applied with a slight brown undertone to show off the contours of the face and
create a lengthening effect.

Sunburn blush, a trend for the cheeks, includes the bridge of the nose when adding blush and
blending it toward the cheeks and up the temples.

Highlighter on the inner corner of the eyes can brighten the eyes and make them appear more
youthful.

Exfoliating removes dead skin cells and brightens the skin.

Permanent makeup, such as cosmetic tattoos, can help recreate favorite makeup looks in a
semi-permanent manner.

Teasing the hair and pulling it into a high ponytail or bun can draw eyes up to the face and make it
appear narrower.

CURLING LASHES can open up the eyes and make them appear larger and more youthful.

# "What are some effective techniques to improve the appearance of [insert subject or object here]?"

Knowledge Base 2 min read July 13, 2026

Essential fatty acids (EFAs) can prevent skin dryness and increase collagen production, leading to a
more youthful appearance.

Collagen supplements may help reduce the signs of skin aging.

**Also worth reading:** ["What are some recommended body modifications for a 2009 G37x that have
proven to be popular and effective in enhancing the car's appearance?"][7] · [What are advanced AV
simulation techniques and how can they improve autonomous vehicle development?][8] · [How can I
improve the appearance of the console lid in my C7 Corvette?][9]

Facial massage can help reduce puffiness and make the skin firmer.

A healthy diet, including fruits, vegetables, antioxidants, and vitamins, can improve skin health.

Adding a few drops of face oil to foundation can give the skin a youthful glow.

Defining one's brows and applying blush correctly can make the face appear slimmer and more
sculpted.

Bangs or lowlights can add an edgy touch to a hairstyle, while a side bang can create symmetry and
reduce the appearance of roundness in the face.

Blush should be applied with a slight brown undertone to show off the contours of the face and
create a lengthening effect.

Sunburn blush, a trend for the cheeks, includes the bridge of the nose when adding blush and
blending it toward the cheeks and up the temples.

Highlighter on the inner corner of the eyes can brighten the eyes and make them appear more
youthful.

Exfoliating removes dead skin cells and brightens the skin.

Permanent makeup, such as cosmetic tattoos, can help recreate favorite makeup looks in a
semi-permanent manner.

Teasing the hair and pulling it into a high ponytail or bun can draw eyes up to the face and make it
appear narrower.

CURLING LASHES can open up the eyes and make them appear larger and more youthful.

complete selection of OEM parts including Track Chain, Track Rollers, Sprocket, Excavator Buckets,

### Take control of your digital channels

# Shape Obstacles into Opportunities with Vorys eControl

[][28]

In a world where eCommerce dynamics shift rapidly, a traditional and laissez-faire product
distribution and sales approach is unsustainable, leaving you vulnerable. The advent of modern
online marketplaces—spearheaded by giants like Amazon and Walmart—has introduced a complex,
challenging landscape that directly impacts your brand’s growth and reputation across all channels.

Since 2014, Vorys eControl has been at the forefront in tackling these challenges and unlocking
growth potential for our brand clients through our proven eControl programs across online and
offline sales channels. We help transform digital channel risks into opportunities for measurable
growth and brand value enhancements with our custom solutions.

[ Request a Consultation ][29]

### Stop swimming upstream

### Your Business Goals Are Our Top Priority

Hyperconnected online marketplaces changed the game. Vorys eControl works with clients to craft
tailored eControl programs, helping protect your business from bad actors and ignite channel growth
in today’s market.

### eCommerce Leaders

Enable profitable growth across digital channels
* Align cross-functional leaders to challenges and opportunities
* Unlock growth with brand-specific KPIs and go-to-market strategy
* Increase authorized sales and decrease unauthorized
* Discover and address which disruptors are causing the most impact
* Benefit from a full suite of legal, data, and technology solutions

### Sales Leaders

Protect long-term customer relationships and optimize performance
* Establish partnership and compliance standards to mitigate disruption
* Enable stronger relationships with existing customers
* Drive new customer interest in products
* Strengthen MAP programs (US only) and pricing policies
* Increase opportunities for sales and customer partnerships

### In-House Legal Counsel

Protect brand integrity and drive revenue
* Transform legal department from cost center to revenue generator
* Implement end-to-end legal foundation and enforcement policies to mitigate sources of disruption
* Protect against gray market sales and illicit actors
* Empower enforcement efforts and quality controls to safeguard consumer experience

### Brand Leaders

Enhance brand equity and win In category
* Elevate brand positioning
* Strengthen brand reputation and consumer trust
* Harmonize traditional and digital sales channels for long-term success
* Outperform category competitors
* Drive higher product valuations
* Access valuable legal guidance and support
